item.title: Congo's president warns next elections can't take place unless conflict is resolved
item.description: Congo’s president says the African nation won't be able to hold elections after his term ends in two years unless the conflict that has gripped the country’s east is resolved

item.title: Kenyan politicians trade accusations of 'goonism' as violence rises ahead of election
item.description: Kenya's political word of the moment is “goonism," used to describe gang-related political violence

item.title: Polls open in UK local elections seen as a verdict on Keir Starmer's leadership
item.description: Polls have opened for midterm local and regional elections that could significantly impact British Prime Minister Keir Starmer
